verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the pricing page listing 'Custom-coded email templates' (mailchimp-docs-37). That suggests HTML templates can be authored, and the Transactional product sends messages via API (mailchimp-docs-2). Nothing in the pack shows templates being created or updated through an API, variable or merge-tag substitution, MJML support, or a code-first, version-controlled workflow. missing for 10: documented template CRUD API endpoints, variable/merge-tag substitution docs, MJML support, version-control or templates-as-code workflow, independent hands-on corroboration.
